spans.s: cl. 10. P. विण्टयति, ‘to kill’ or ‘to perish’, Dhātup. xxxii, 116 (v.l.)
w.r. for वि-टङ्क, Vcar.
See under 3. विष्.
विण्—मूत्र n. (sg. or du.) feces and urine, Mn. iv, 48 &c.
in comp. for 3. विष्.

(of doubtful derivation) the Vīṇā or Indian lute (an instrument of the guitar kind, supposed to have been invented by Nārada q.v., usually having seven wires or strings raised upon nineteen frets or supports fixed on a long rounded board, towards the ends of which are two large gourds; its compass is said to be two octaves, but it has many varieties according to the number of strings &c.), TS.; ŚBr. &c. &c.
(in astrol.) a partic. configuration of the stars (when all planets are situated in 7 houses), VarBṛS.
lightning, L.
N. of a Yoginī, Cat.
of a river, MBh.
वीणा—कर्ण m. ‘Lute-ear’, N. of a man, Hit.
वीणा—गणकिन् m. a music-master, the leader of a musical band, ĀpŚr.
वी॑णा—गणगिन् (वी॑णा-), m. id., ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; KātyŚr.
वीणा—गाथि॑न् m. a lute-player, TBr.; ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.
वीणा—तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
वीणा—तूणव n. sg. lutes and flutes, ĀpŚr.
वीणा—दण्ड m. ‘lute-stick’, the neck or long rounded board of a lute, L.
वीणा—दत्त m. N. of a Gandharva, Kathās.
वीणा˚नुबन्ध (वीणान्˚) m. the tie of a lute (or lower part of one of its ends where the wires are fixed), L.
वीणा—पणव-तूण-वत् mfn. (तूण for तूनव) furnished with a lute and a drum and a flute, R.
वीणा—पाणि m. ‘Lute-hand’, N. of Nārada, Pañcar.
वीणा—प्रसेव m. the damper on a lute, L.
वीणा—भिद् f. a kind of lute, MW.
वीणा—रव m. (ifc. f(आ). ) the sound of a lute, Kathās.
वीणा—रव mfn. humming like a lute (आ f. N. of a fly), Pañcat.
वीणा—वंश-शलाका f. around-headed peg round which the string of a l˚ is bound, L.
वीणा—वत् mfn. possessed of a lute (अती f. N. of a woman), Pāṇ. vi, 1, 219, Sch.
= प्रवीण, Drāhy., Sch.
वीणा—वत्स-राज m. N. of a king, Pañcat.
वीणा—वाद॑ m. a lute-player, lutanist, VS.; ŚBr.; ĀpŚr.
playing on a lute, Bhartṛ.
वीणा—वादक m. a lutanist, L.
वीणा—वादन n. a plectrum for sounding a lute, L.
वीणा—वाद्य n. playing on a lute, L.
वीणा—विनोद m. N. of a Vidyādhara, Bālar.
वीणा—शिल्प n. the art of playing on the lute, Pañcar.
वीणा˚स्य (वीणास्य) m. ‘Lute-faced’, N. of Nārada, L.
वीणा—हस्त mfn. holding a lute in his hand (Śiva), Śivag.
g. सिध्मादि.
furnished with a lute, playing on a lute, Megh.; Kathās.
